data.strFullDescription: [h2][b]It’s time to journey back to the stars![/b]  [/h2][p]Dive into the enchanting worlds of LUNAR: Silver Star Story Complete and LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue Complete, two beloved JRPGs that have captured the hearts of gamers for generations. [/p][h2]LUNAR: Silver Star Story[/h2][p]LUNAR: Silver Star Story introduces Alex, an aspiring Dragonmaster who bands together with his friends to combat the perilous emergence of the Magic Emperor and stop him from taking over the world. [/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3255380/extras/627a9660e04c14aa5cd28aeb92536ef3.poster.avif?t=1760075958" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3255380/extras/627a9660e04c14aa5cd28aeb92536ef3.webm?t=1760075958" width="640" height="360"][/imgvid][/p][h2]LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue[/h2][p]LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue picks up a thousand years later, and follows Hiro and his friends as they set out in search of the Goddess Althena alongside an enigmatic girl named Lucia. On this grand quest, fend off enemies like Borgan and White Knight Leo, who hunt down the group to eradicate what they deem to be the "Destroyer of Lunar." [/p][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3255380/extras/13c37dfa3b446a11d2d9abfd35f9dfae.poster.avif?t=1760075958" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3255380/extras/13c37dfa3b446a11d2d9abfd35f9dfae.webm?t=1760075958" width="640" height="360"][/imgvid][/p][p]This definitive remastered edition features enhanced graphics, audio, and quality-of-life improvements that will satiate that hunger for 90s nostalgia--better than you remember! Embark on these two adventures with updated language support, now available in English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, French, and German. [/p][h2][b]Master the Turn-Based Battle System[/b] [/h2][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3255380/extras/64a00ba6868e29ded3b8710f16e4254d.poster.avif?t=1760075958" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3255380/extras/64a00ba6868e29ded3b8710f16e4254d.webm?t=1760075958" width="640" height="360"][/imgvid][/p][p]Engage in turn-based combat using your party’s arsenal of magic, skills, and items. Each character possesses defined strengths and unique skills that can be leveled up and learned throughout your journey. In LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue Complete, explore the Crest System, in which characters may acquire benefits such as stat boosts and high-level magic from crest synergies. [/p][h2][b]Remastered Animated Cutscenes[/b]  [/h2][p][imgvid poster.avif="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3255380/extras/28d61053fa7da2889d11972ede89c225.poster.avif?t=1760075958" webm="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3255380/extras/28d61053fa7da2889d11972ede89c225.webm?t=1760075958" width="640" height="360"][/imgvid][/p][p]As you explore, immerse yourself deeper within the universe with fully voiced in-game scenes and animated cutscenes, now with remastered graphics.    [/p][h2][b]Quality of Life Improvements [/b] [/h2][p]Battle speed can now be adjusted at any point during battle, with three speeds to choose from. In LUNAR: Silver Star Story Complete, enjoy a toggleable inventory management system in which all characters in the party share a combined inventory. Also in LUNAR 1, we've improved the Auto Battle system by making it possible for players to customize the CPU behavior of individual characters. [/p][h2][b]Play the Remastered Mode... or the Classic Mode! [/b] [/h2][p][b]Remastered Mode[/b] [/p][p]Embark on the iconic adventures of LUNAR 1 and LUNAR 2 with all the remastered features, such as: widescreen (16:9) layout, enhanced sound and graphics, and updated character portrait sprites, menu icons, and bromides! [/p][p][b]Classic Mode[/b]  [/p][p]If nostalgia is what you crave, switch it over to the classic mode! Experience retro visuals with a 4:3 screen; original cutscenes, effects, and icons; three CRT filter options; and more. [/p]
data.strSnippet: Dive into the enchanting worlds of LUNAR: Silver Star Story Complete and LUNAR 2: Eternal Blue Complete! Tag along on Alex and Hiro's quests and challenge enemies like the Magic Emperor and God of Destruction to save the world from dire peril in two adventures set 1000 years apart from each other!
